title: fix(metadata-protocol): os migrate packageless-overlays moves an email template row of a locale the base does not ship as the pair's own member
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Wh1GxXkF35pyjEZvT2LLas)_

Fixes #28904

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os migrate packageless-overlays` 现在能迁移「基础包不发运该语言」的旧版无包邮件模板行（例如只发运 `en-US` 的模板的 `zh-CN` 翻译）：把它作为配对包 `BASE.custom` 自己的该语言成员写入，不带 `overrides` 声明，回读确认后再删除无包行，结果报 `moved` 并注明 `addedMember`。
- **为什么改**：以前仪式给这类行加上 `overrides` 再存入配对包，被 #28777 的写入闸门拒绝（基础包不发运该语言），结果 `failed`、行原地不动；客户已有的翻译邮件迁不走。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改迁移仪式的分支和 CLI 的展示文字；写入闸门、读取侧、关闭无包写入的判定都不变。基础包发运的语言照旧按声明式覆盖迁移。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts` 的 `addedMemberOf` 与迁移循环第 2、3 步的 `[#28904]` 分支；`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/packageless-overlays.ts` 的预览与报告两行。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts -t 28904`，预期 5/5 通过（main 上 2 红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

An `email_template` is one item per `(name, locale)` (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`). The ceremony classified a package-less row against the packages that ship its NAME, so a `zh-CN` row of a template the base ships in `en-US` only was `movable`, and the move saved it into the pair declaring `overrides: { package: BASE, basedOn }`. The override write gate counts shippers at the bundle member and refuses that declaration (`declared_package_ships_no_such_item`, #28777), so the outcome was `failed` and the row stayed.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`:

- `addedMemberOf` (private): the bundle member a row's body is, when the base ships the name but not that member, counted as `overrideWriteVerdict` counts a shipper (the artifacts at that member, less any another member answers, bound to the base). `undefined` for a name-identified type and for a shipped member.
- The census sets `addedMember` on such a `movable` row (new optional field of `PackagelessOverlayRow`). The disposition vocabulary is unchanged.
- The move, for a row with `addedMember`: step 2 saves the body into the pair with NO `overrides` (a stored `overrides` naming the base is dropped), so no `basedOn` is needed or recorded and a base without a version does not fail it; step 3 reads back the pair's row at that member and requires it to declare nothing (`isOwnMemberRow`); step 4 deletes the unbound row as before, its history message naming the member. Outcome: `{ outcome: 'moved', packageId: PAIR, addedMember }` (a new arm of `PackagelessOverlayOutcome`, no new outcome word).
- Every other row moves exactly as before.
- The close (`packagelessCloseSubject`) is unchanged: it judges the declared-override move only, so an unshipped member's package-less write stays open, as on `main`. Its docblock now says why.

`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/packageless-overlays.ts`: the preview lists such a row as `→ PAIR (its own member; BASE ships none at zh-CN)` instead of `(overrides BASE)`, the `--apply` line reads `moved into PAIR (as its own member zh-CN)` instead of `(basedOn …)`, and the `--json` row carries `addedMember` and omits `basedOn` for it. This file is in the claim's surface conditionally ("only if the preview needs a new outcome word"); no word was added, but without this edit the preview and report would print an `overrides` / `basedOn` the move does not record.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`, new describe `[#28904] …` (5 cases, the file's real engine, protocol and in-memory driver; the package ships `acme.digest` in `en-US` only):

1. an unshipped locale moves into the pair as its own member with no `overrides`; subject, `bodyHtml`, `bodyText`, `replyTo` and `fromOverride` are unchanged on the execution list the send path reads and on the by-name read, at once and after a restart; the base's `en-US` member is untouched; a re-run moves 0;
2. an unshipped-locale row whose stored body declares the base: the declaration is dropped on the move;
3. READ BACK FIRST: a save that writes nothing keeps the unbound row and reports `failed`;
4. CONTROL: a shipped locale (`acme.welcome` `zh-CN`) still moves as the declared override with `basedOn`;
5. the #28777 refusal is unchanged: after the move, a save into the pair DECLARING an override of the unshipped locale answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.

Forced test edits: none. Two docblocks in the same file that said the ceremony cannot move an unshipped member (the file header and `resetZh`) now say it moves it as the pair's own member and its package-less reset stays open; comment-only.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on the fix</summary>

Red: `metadata-protocol` built from `main`'s source (the fix held out of the tree), cases 1 and 2 red (`os-verify-lock` VERDICT command-exit 1, 2 failed / 2 passed): the census had no `addedMember`, and the move answered `failed` where `moved` was expected.

Green at `505a5ab7` and again at `c62af5d2`: 5/5; the three ceremony suites (`environment-overlay-email-locale-restart`, `protocol-packageless-overlay-migration`, `environment-overlay-five-types`) 87/87.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per pinned behaviour; each leg through ablation-replace.mjs, metadata-protocol rebuilt, ablation-dist-preflight.mjs marker present, then restored to the HEAD blob and preflight --absent)</summary>

- A1, census `addedMember` ignored by the move (the old declared-override save): cases 1, 2, 3 red; case 1's outcome became `failed` with `… declares an override of 'com.acme.mail', which ships no email_template named 'acme.digest' with locale 'zh-CN' …`.
- A2, keep a stored `overrides` on the member save: case 2 red (`failed` where `moved`).
- A3, member read-back always accepts: case 3 red (`moved` where `failed`).
- A4, the gate's `declared_package_ships_no_such_item` branch disabled (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`, mutated and restored, not in the diff): case 5 red (`expected undefined to match object { code, status }`).

Every restore: `git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker absent from `dist/`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The close stays as on `main`.** #28576 ruling 2 closes a package-less write where the ceremony would move the row and the move can succeed. The close still reads the declared-override move only, so it keeps the unshipped member's package-less write open, now while the ceremony can move that row. Closing it too would refuse a write accepted today (a `(narrowing)` arm), needs refusal text in `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` (next on this seat, #28905) that does not tell the author to declare `overrides`, and changes the spec registry entry's prose. Raised in the report's `open_questions`, not done here.
- **The spec migration entry's prose** (`18.packageless-overlay-write-closed`, `replacement`) still lists "an email template locale the base does not ship" among the `failed` moves and says each `movable` row is moved declaring `overrides`. After this PR such a row moves as the pair's own member. `packages/spec/**` is out of this card's surface; reported to the seat for the spec lane.
- **#28780's row kind** (a row already IN the pair declaring an override of an unshipped locale, stored before #28777) is not touched. This move takes the same reading as #28780's "drop `overrides`" option: a member the base does not ship enters the pair declaring nothing.
- `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#migratePackagelessOverlays`'s docblock in `protocol.ts` still says "as a declared override". The module header is the stated authority and is updated; `protocol.ts` is outside the claim's surface.
- Version history: the move carries what it carried before (a save into the pair and the unbound row's delete tombstone); no history is copied.

## Verification

All at head `2ebd0841` unless noted (the last commit after the package runs is comment-only in a test file).

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck exit 0; test 300 files passed, 4 skipped, 22100 tests passed (at `d485bebc`).
- `@objectstack/objectql` typecheck exit 0; test 527 files, 10143 tests passed (at `d485bebc`).
- `@objectstack/cli` typecheck exit 0; `vitest run --project unit` 372 files, 5250 tests passed (at `d485bebc`). The integration tier is declared to CI.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over `packages/metadata-protocol/src`, `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate` and the test file: exit 0, no findings.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 62 families; 62 run; 59 exit 0 at first run, 3 exit 3 on prerequisites and re-run exit 0 on the same head (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` once the unbuilt packages had dist). `--ran` with exit codes: "62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero.
- Full dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
- `origin/main` merged once before opening (`79774af3`).

Changeset `.changeset/28904-packageless-overlays-added-member.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/cli` patch, both declaration lines.
